items.observation: Timeout handling discards captured output and subprocess.run does not explicitly terminate the check process group.

resolution.cause: Output was accumulated in memory and discarded on timeout; descendants had no explicit termination path.
resolution.correction: Stream output to retained logs, terminate timed-out process groups or Windows process trees, and report cleanup or launch failure.
resolution.prevention: tests/project/test_processes.py exercises partial diagnostics and a real descendant that must not survive timeout.

items.observation: Decision metadata is excluded from the execution digest, and current milestone display does not require current task definitions.

resolution.cause: Execution hashing excluded decisions and task definitions; readiness could display old milestone results.
resolution.correction: Validate report structure, bind task and decision definitions, reject mid-run drift and failed runs, and require matching clean committed release proof.
resolution.prevention: tests/project/test_delivery.py covers changed decisions, invalid state, malformed reports, partial selection and dirty-build release claims.

items.observation: Milestone-sized tasks lack focused delivery context, observable scenario bindings and a tracked correction loop.

resolution.cause: Tasks described broad phases without a validated link between user outcomes, risks and corrective work.
resolution.correction: Add focused plans, five product scenarios, change-risk check mappings, task context and evidence-backed feedback resolution; preserve cancelled plans without blocking a delivered replacement.
resolution.prevention: tests/project/test_delivery.py rejects uncovered risks and premature feedback closure and checks cancellation, selection and release blockers.

items.observation: Accepted history preservation is specified but has no comparison with the reviewed Git base.

resolution.cause: History preservation relied on instructions without comparing the reviewed revision.
resolution.correction: Compare accepted tasks and decisions against an explicit Git base in local review and CI; disclose when no comparison is available.
resolution.prevention: tests/project/test_delivery.py uses isolated commits to reject rewritten decisions and reopened completed tasks.

items.observation: Inherited Cargo workspace aliases can hide forbidden infrastructure or internal-layer dependencies from the original boundary check.

resolution.cause: The dependency checker inspected child-manifest aliases without resolving workspace definitions.
resolution.correction: Resolve inherited and local dependency identities before enforcing layer boundaries.
resolution.prevention: tests/project/test_architecture.py covers inherited database aliases and target-specific internal dependencies.

items.observation: The original default harness would eventually run packaged and soak checks on every native change, while the stability timeout was shorter than the contractual two-hour workload.

resolution.cause: Daily and release-only checks shared one execution path and the soak deadline could not accommodate the contract workload.
resolution.correction: Add change versus release cadence, explicit manual release validation, a longer release job budget and a bounded soak deadline.
resolution.prevention: tests/project/test_delivery.py checks that default runs omit release work explicitly and that selected release gates remain blocked until executed.

items.observation: The first native run found locale-dependent history decoding, an incorrect relative frontend hook, and source changes during Tauri manifest normalization; local Linux checks did not cover those integration paths.

resolution.cause: Git history JSON used locale-dependent subprocess text decoding; Tauri discovered the nested UI package and normalized a shorthand build dependency during startup.
resolution.correction: Parse Git JSON from UTF-8 bytes, execute frontend hooks within the discovered UI package, and declare the normalized build dependency explicitly. Retain end-of-run source identity and changed paths for future build-write diagnostics.
resolution.prevention: A regression simulates legacy Windows text decoding, and actual Windows CI passes all 76 Python tests and the desktop release build with unchanged source inputs.

items.observation: Schema-valid indicator.remove requests and AI tool calls decode into ChartRemoveLayer Rust variants because untagged unions ignore inline const discriminators.
Schema-valid integral timestamp encodings 1.0 and 1e0 are accepted by Python and JavaScript but rejected by the Rust decode_line path.

Prepending the valid audit task causes 16 failures and 34 errors among 76 Python tests because ProjectFixture mutates ledger.tasks[0] and assumes a historical check list. Appending restores the baseline but does not repair the coupling.
rust_boundaries rejects a rusqlite dependency in crates/domain but returns no errors for the same scopehub-domain package at crates/nested/domain.
Cargo default-members includes only domain and worker-host. Both hosted test and Clippy commands use defaults; desktop:build compiles the Windows application without executing its tests.
An isolated Linux probe shows run_logged returns exit_code=0 and reason=null while a spawned child remains alive and writes a marker afterward. Timeout cleanup does not cover normal root exit.

In an explicitly synthetic harness-selection probe, changing rust-contracts-workers to planned/null yields exit 0 and report passed under require-windows, although M0 verification is blocked. CI does not enforce a preserved implemented gate set.
Authenticated read-only inspection found main protected=false and no repository rulesets. Both PR verification contexts pass, but server settings do not require them before integration.

Dependency review remains planned and release-cadence; external Actions use mutable tags or stable. Locks support reproducible package resolution but do not establish advisory, notice or workflow-source review.
